EDA-07Missing Default Case In Chunk Encoding Format Switch
Assetapi/clients/node_client.go
StatusResolved: See Resolution
RatingSeverity: LowImpact: MediumLikelihood: Low
<|det|>title [68, 256, 178, 273]<|/det|>Description <|det|>text [65, 295, 932, 361]<|/det|>The Getchunks() function in api/clients/node_client.go lacks a default case in its switch statement that handles chunk encoding formats. If a future protobuf version adds a new encoding format (e.g., ZSTD = 3) and operator nodes are upgraded before the client code, the switch statement will fall through with both chunk and err remaining nil. This causes nil to be assigned to chunks[ii] at line [150], which could lead to nil pointer dereferences downstream. <|det|>text [70, 367, 470, 523]<|/det|>api/clients/node_client.go:124 switch reply.getChunkEncodingFormat() { caseqproode.ChunkEncodingFormat.G442K: chunk, err = new(encoding.Frame).DeserializeGorak(data) caseqprocode.ChunkEncodingFormat.G0B: chunk, err = new(encoding.Frame).Deserialize(data) caseqprocode.ChunkEncodingFormat.UNKNOWN: chunk, err = new(encoding.Frame).Deserialize(data) // ... error handling // 测试 Missing default case } if err != nil { /* ... */ } chunks[i] = chunk // @audit Can assign nil if no case matched <|det|>text [66, 532, 930, 562]<|/det|>The likelihood is low as it requires a version mismatch between protobuf definitions and client code. The impact is medium as it causes service disruption via panic but no data corruption or security compromise. <|det|>title [68, 595, 238, 610]<|/det|>Recommendations <|det|>text [67, 633, 603, 649]<|/det|>Add a default case that returns an error for unhandled encoding formats: <|det|>text [70, 657, 367, 673]<|/det|>api/clients/node_client.go:GetChunks() <|det|>text [70, 677, 534, 768]<|/det|>default: chunks4cn <- RetrievedChunks{ OperatorID: opID, Err: fmt.errorf("unsupported chunk encoding format: %v", reply.GetChunkEncodingFormat(), Chunks: nil, } return <|det|>title [68, 804, 168, 819]<|/det|>Resolution <|det|>text [68, 843, 497, 859]<|/det|>The recommendation has been implemented in PR #2158. <|det|>footer [74, 924, 206, 945]<|/det|>signalch time <|det|>page_number [810, 931, 882, 946]<|/det|>Page | 18
